title: Understanding Chance Error
text: Chance error refers to the variability in survey results due to the random nature of sampling. It is influenced by the sample size.

title: Effect of Sample Size on Chance Error
text: Increasing the sample size generally reduces the chance error, making the survey results more reliable.

title: Comparing Sample Sizes
text: Consider the original sample size of $$100$$ and the updated sample size of $$200$$. How does this change affect the chance error?

title: Reminder Emails and Response Rate
text: Sending reminder emails can increase the response rate, which can also affect the chance error.

title: Impact of Increased Responses
text: With more responses, the survey results are likely to be more accurate, reducing the chance error.

title: Combining Effects of Updates
text: Consider both the increased sample size and the reminder emails. How do these updates together affect the chance error?
